data.body: **P2 — Do not turn MDC snapshot failure into terminal workflow failure.** An ordinary exception from `MDC.getCopyOfContextMap()` is passed through `finishInvocation`, producing a durable `FAILED` output before the handler or any start hook runs. A transient/custom logging-binding failure can therefore permanently fail user work. For nonfatal snapshot errors, fall back to the prior no-preservation behavior or propagate an invocation-level infrastructure failure instead of emitting durable `FAILED`.
